name: How the AI processes information
vision_statement: AI requests are handled in the best way possible, given all relevant information.
opportunities: Long-term memory, objectives and guidance, and what comes to mind unasked, are opportunities beyond the parts that answer one request. Turning a request into a measured target, and judging quality against a profile, can each be improved without changing how a single request is answered.
solution_coherence: Intelligence turns one request into a response. Higher Mind keeps the long view through Long-Term Memory, Objectives and Guidance, which gives an infrequent longer-term nudge. Critical Thinking turns the request into a target with a budget through Metric Translation, records it through ESOI Application, and holds the result to it through Goal Completion and Response Quality. Subconscious finds and prepares information through Cards From Files, Context Retriever and Intuition. Mind takes the request in through Context Intake, breaks it into pieces through Planner, passes each piece to a worker through Delegation and writes the response through Response Writer. Mind asks for a signal before a risky piece from Nervous System, and for the decision for the person from Judgment Calls. An unmet goal sends the flow back to the planning step within the request's budget, and when the budget or the authority runs out the flow goes to Judgment Calls. Proactivity says what is due without being asked. Prioritization says what matters first among the due work and the other work waiting, so the system acts unasked on the most important work first.
